name: Runtime - Upstream Issue Release Watch
owner_workflow: Runtime upstream escalation watch (openclaw/openclaw#155478 release re-test)
contract_reason: Owner-directed 2026-09-21 upstream escalation lane. Enabled job was flagged enabled_job_missing_freshness_contract because it has no state/cron-contracts entry, so cron freshness cannot tell a live watcher from an ungoverned job. The job fires only when the installed OpenClaw version changes; it writes no tmp packet, so its durable proof surface is the Upstream Escalation Register it updates. Registration clears the P1 and pins schedule, payload, trigger, and delivery so silent drift is visible.
description: Re-test upstream issue #155478 when the installed OpenClaw version changes. Read-only trigger; no auto-posting. Filing/commenting stays owner-approved.

payload.message: Upstream release re-test for the memory_search KNN child spawn issue (closed upstream as superseded). If the appended trigger detail reports a version change, run this re-test: (1) confirm whether the installed build now contains PR #153832 (perf(memory-core): reuse native KNN query processes, merged 2026-09-20T18:36:31Z, implemented our Ask 1). No release on or before 2026.9.5 contains it, so any build newer than that should; (2) inspect dist/extensions/memory-core/memory-search-knn.child.js for a request-ID / newline-delimited protocol instead of the old one-shot process.stdin.once(end) read, and dist/extensions/memory-core/manager-runtime.js for a reused or pooled KNN child instead of a per-query spawn at runVectorKnnInSubprocess; (3) re-run scripts/knn_spawn_probe.mjs for a current spawn-cost table and compare against the recorded baseline (bare node --version median 1,696 ms; real child median 1,778 ms on 2026-09-21); (4) check Ask 2, the SQLite pragma half upstream explicitly left open: whether memory-search-knn.child.js now sets PRAGMA mmap_size or cache_size beyond query_only and busy_timeout. Then report a fixed / partially-fixed / regressed / unmoved verdict in one short message to Randall, and update 06. Playbooks/Project Continuity/Upstream Escalation Register.md. Note the upstream issue is CLOSED, so a regression needs a NEW issue rather than a reopen, and filing or commenting remains owner-approved. If this is a manually forced test run with no version change, verify the plumbing only and reply with a single line confirming the watch executes; do not imply a new release.

stop_lines: Read-only release watch; it does not file or comment upstream without owner approval.
No cron schedule/config/runtime mutation from this contract.
No finance/canon/portfolio mutation, capital, account, order, or execution authority.
No external delivery mutation and no owner-approval inference.
